segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: The peppermint balloon drifted down through the swirling snow of the East Chasm.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: The canyon walls were sheer cliffs of jagged black rock, but the canyon floor looked like an explosion in a colossal clock factory. Centuries of discarded machinery were piled fifty feet high: rusted iron balance wheels, giant brass pendulums, snapped springs, and mountains of hollow toy parts half-buried in the snow.

segments.speaker: hero
segments.text: Keep her steady, Titan,

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: you say, peering over the wicker edge.

segments.speaker: hero
segments.text: Look for an entrance.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Titan set the balloon down on a snowy ledge right in front of a colossal, rusted vault door built directly into the cliff face. Above the door was a hand-painted wooden sign with crooked white lettering:

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: PRIVATE PROPERTY. KEEP OUT. THIS MEANS YOU, NUTCRACKERS. AND ESPECIALLY YOU, SANTA.

segments.speaker: pip
segments.text: This is Barnaby's workshop,

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Titan whispered, his big black-spotted ears twitching nervously.

segments.speaker: pip
segments.text: He doesn't like visitors. Or noise. Or people who touch his stuff.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Pip hopped out of the basket onto the snow, puffing his green trench coat out with grandiose pride.

segments.speaker: pip
segments.text: Nonsense!

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Pip declared, adjusting his houndstooth cap.

segments.speaker: pip
segments.text: Master Detective Pip possesses the diplomatic charm of a seasoned ambassador! A simple, professional knocking sequence shall alert our grumpy friend to my prestigious arrival!

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Pip strutted up to the iron door. Beside the latch sat an antique, carved wooden clown head with an open brass horn in its mouth.

segments.speaker: pip
segments.text: Do not fear, recruit,

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Pip said, winking at you.

segments.speaker: pip
segments.text: Watch the master at work.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Pip leaned forward and gave the horn a mighty, confident HONK.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: AHOOOOO-GA!

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: A shower of red sparks shot out of the clown's ears. Deep inside the canyon walls, a massive tripwire snapped with a violent TWANG!
